## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 360 captures during July 2024. This is the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The capture total is presented as the recorded monthly activity for the site.

## Image quality

Of the 360 captures, 14 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.9. This measure records the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the monthly capture total. Image quality results for July 2024 therefore comprise 14 ungradable captures and an ungradable rate of 3.9.

## Grading

The grading results recorded 94 referable cases. The median lag was 9. This is the reported midpoint for the time between capture and grading during July 2024. Together, the referable result and median lag summarise the grading outcome and timeliness recorded for West Gate Eye Clinic in the month.
